title: What is a passage barrier?
text: Total and partial passage classifications describe assessed obstruction at a structure; passability is not proof of access through the whole stream network.

title: Habitat is not connectivity
text: Upstream habitat gain requires habitat survey and fish-access information; a single crossing record cannot establish that coho or kokanee can reach all habitat above it.

title: First rain, road runoff
text: 6PPD-quinone from tire wear is toxic to coho at very low concentrations; the first-flush banner is a rain-and-dry-days demo heuristic, not a chemical measurement.

title: Room for more shade
text: The WRIA 8 2025 progress report records 28.6 acres of Sammamish River riparian planting against a 69-acre goal, about 41 percent.

title: A return route for kokanee
text: The City of Sammamish describes Zackuse Creek fish-passage and stream restoration as work to improve native kokanee spawning habitat.

title: A historical warning
text: Fewer than 20 kokanee returned in the 2017–18 winter run; this is historical context, not a current population estimate.

title: Sampling, not a sensor
text: King County documents 6PPD-quinone sampling context at the Sammamish River near SR 522 and I-405; this app provides no live chemistry readings.
